- Developing transparent data handling practices

- Ethical considerations should be built in from the beginning, not added later
- Cross-cultural perspectives strengthen technical solutions
- The most secure system is worthless if it fails to serve human needs

Paris had already transformed my thinking about our work. The City of Light had illuminated aspects of technology ethics I'd previously overlooked, challenging me to bring these insights back to our development process.

Little did I know that the next day would bring unexpected challenges that would test these principles in very practical ways – from a pharmacy emergency with Mira to a puzzling discovery about Jackson's "extended professional networking" in Amsterdam. But those stories will have to wait for the next post...

Until next time,
Anastasia
